{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A structured wool-blend blazer, relaxed fit, hip length, charcoal grey (#36454F), heavy woven fabric.
Tailored wool trousers, straight leg, full ankle length, navy blue (#000080), medium-weight gabardine.
A fine-knit merino sweater, crew neck, hip length, cream white (#FFFDD0), soft thermal knit.
Black leather ankle boots with a low block heel, rounded toe, waterproof finish, smooth calfskin.
This ensemble works because it balances professional polish with practical warmth for walking in freezing, snowy conditions. The dark neutral tones provide a sleek, business-appropriate aesthetic while the thick fabrics protect against the -10°C temperature and road salt. You can move comfortably for your twenty-minute walk without sacrificing the neat dress code required for the meeting."}
